test_title: PYST 17: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the letter - cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

PROVOCATION, OOVOXATIR, ?, TONAV, AIO
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

The pattern followed is:-

1. Removing the first and last letters, 

2. Exchanging the new end letters.

3. Subtracting 5 from the positional value of the middle letter.

The complete pattern is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7496bb24192b264f5532ae973db83a97f31732055450f4b16dac4204324cd3d4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"IVOSATO"**.
